aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 11.1.7.1, 11.1.7.2 and 11.1.7.3 DO construct form and loop control source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_113.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 245 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. authored_facets is 1788 and the fixture review states are 1770 reference-validated, 274 source-reviewed and 1 needs-oracle with zero stale groups; the tests directory is byte-identical to its state before the packet. This batch was blocked with two findings, both closed. The packet had added covers metadata headers to four pre-existing fixture files, binding ten facets, raising authored_facets to 1798 and staling four reference-validated review groups; source registration is not fixture approval and confers no execution credit. A single file-level covers line had also bound R1123_invalid to four distinct negatives at once, destroying per-facet attribution. Removing the bindings caused the audit to abort, which exposed a genuine structural coupling diagnosed in tests/suite_data.py: validate_case_requirement is invoked only once a rule is a catalogued requirement and raises on an empty facet list, while covers headers are optional for numbered rules, so registering C1121 and R1123 structurally forces their pre-existing cases to gain covers metadata. Only two consistent outcomes existed, and a source packet may not bind fixtures, so this was ruled a fixture migration for which the ledger shows precedent as a dedicated batch type with independent fixture review. The two requirements were deferred rather than dropped: C1121, R1123 and their fine units are dispositioned unresolved and remain fully accounted, each with an explicit rationale naming the reason and the migration followup. Seven non-numbered base units are newly accounted while two previously accounted numbered units move into unresolved, so the net delta is five accounted base units and four unresolved fine units; the reviewer confirmed independently that this is an honest deferral rather than a quiet drop. The 31 registered numbered requirements, the two permissions including the end-do only-from-within permission and restriction split, and the deliberate decision not to own the iteration-count rule or the post-loop DO variable value all stand. No DO construct execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
